welcome.intro: Welcome to Roxys Travel Plan — a personal map of hand-picked places for your trip. Tap Import my Recommendation List and choose the file we emailed you. Your places then work right here on the map, even offline. (This is placeholder text the agency can edit later.)
welcome.noFile: Please choose the file the agency emailed you.
welcome.badFile: That file could not be read. Make sure it is the Recommendation List we sent you.

filters.title: Filters
settings.title: Settings
settings.offline.hint: Download a country's map to use it without a connection. Your places always work offline.
settings.offline.unavailable: No offline map is published for this country yet.
expiry.title: Your travel access has ended
expiry.body: This map was available only during your travel dates. We hope you had an amazing trip!

admin.import.title: Import CSV
admin.import.hint: One CSV file = one category. Columns are matched automatically; adjust the mapping if needed. Blank rows are skipped.

admin.gen.title: Generate a Recommendation List
admin.gen.hint: Build a scoped Recommendation List for one client. It contains only the chosen countries × categories plus a travel-date range. No password is added.
admin.gen.itineraryHint: Optional — bundles the CRM route into every export.
admin.gen.needDates: Set both valid-from and valid-until dates.
admin.gen.needSelection: Select at least one country and one category.

admin.gen.embedHint: Paste this into your website's HTML / embed block (e.g. a Wix “Embed HTML” element).
admin.data.title: Master data
admin.data.hint: The master dataset lives as data/master.json in the repository. Export it after editing and commit it back to GitHub.
admin.data.resetConfirm: Replace all current data with the built-in seed data?
admin.poi.urlHint: Paste a Google Maps link → fills name, coordinates and country.

admin.texts.title: Editable texts
admin.texts.hint: Edit the messages travelers see. Save here, then publish the site to make changes live.

admin.desktop.welcomeHint: Keep your master list in a Google Drive or OneDrive folder so it syncs between your computers. Open your existing list, or start a new one.
admin.desktop.unsavedBody: You have unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
admin.desktop.hint: Your master list is a file on this computer. Keep it in a Google Drive or OneDrive folder and it syncs to your other computer. Edit, then Save. Wait for the drive's “synced” check before switching computers.
admin.desktop.importHint: Bring points from another Roxys list file into this one.
admin.docs.title: Document storage
admin.docs.hint: Generated client files (Recommendation List, KML, website map, CSV) are saved here, under subfolders. Point this at a Google Drive / OneDrive folder to sync them between machines.
admin.docs.none: Not set yet — you'll be asked where to save each file until you choose a folder.
